method: Read all 12 cards, all evidence claim locators, matching historical-basemap registry records, modern and curated registries; independently opened all 24 cited pages and read the relevant passages. Source claims and cultural attributions were checked separately from imported chronology and geometry.

globalFindings: All 49 section items have supporting source passages. Three reviewed wording corrections have been applied and all focused narratives are accepted.
None of these chapters independently researches full state lifetimes, successor links or historical border geometry.
Identity and chronology revise verdicts apply to registry interpretation and completeness; they do not reject supported local cultural facts.
Source diversification is still thin for several cards: two UNESCO property pages provide complementary subjects, not independent corroboration of each claim.
No precise border verification was performed and no colonial cultural attribution was assumed.
